description: This file defines a CartProvider class for managing a list of FoodItem objects in a food delivery app, including adding, removing, and updating quantities of food items.

classes.name: CartProvider
classes.description: Provides methods to add, remove, and update quantities of FoodItem objects in the cart.

methods.name: addToList
methods.description: Adds a FoodItem to the cart; if the item already exists, increases its quantity.

methods.name: removeFromList
methods.description: Removes a FoodItem from the cart or decreases its quantity if greater than one.

methods.name: increaseItemQuantity
methods.description: Increases the quantity of a FoodItem.

methods.name: decreaseItemQuantity
methods.description: Decreases the quantity of a FoodItem.
